mechanism: Ganciclovir may cause CNS effects (confusion, hallucinations, seizures) which are potentiated by scopolamine's anticholinergic and CNS depressant properties, increasing risk of delirium and neurological complications.
action: Monitor closely for CNS adverse effects including confusion, agitation, and delirium; consider alternative anticholinergic agents if possible or use scopolamine at lowest effective dose with careful observation.
